about: Rules of the live in-game model's weekly review. Same process as the pregame model: walk-forward re-fits scored play by play against the weights in force, on games neither side saw.

categories.name: Possession value
categories.what: expected points of the drive in progress, by field position, down and distance

categories.name: Score, possession and pregame fade
categories.what: how much the possession counts and how fast GridIron's pregame margin fades as the clock runs

categories.name: Live uncertainty
categories.what: how wide the range of final margins is at each point of the game

categories.name: Tail calibration
categories.what: a correction for over- or under-confidence near 0% and 100%

categories.name: Live total
categories.what: how the projected final total combines the score so far, GridIron's pregame total and the clock
